notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Not a huge update, some of the bugs took some digging to work out.


 Fixed a few typos
 Resolved issue where agreeing to an investor deal during a Fundraiser would result in the deal just vanishing, it should now work and show up like any other financing deal
 Improved theatrical distribution process to avoid situations where your film is released in theaters but gets stuck at $0 in box office revenue
 Adjusted how distribution companies decide whether to keep your film in theaters or pull it, should generally result in your films being in theaters longer than previously
 The salary actors ask for in medium production has been increased, there will likely be further changes to this as medium productions can sometimes be a little too 'safe'
 Resolved bug that could show incorrect distribution deal info if you click Cancel when viewing distribution offers in the Licensing area
 Fixed error when adding award nomination history to movies, likely only affected AI studios


As always please feel free to stop by the Steam discussions or email support@caffeinedependentsoftware.com with any comments/questions/concerns.  Hope everyone is enjoying the summer sale!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, got another update for you, hot off the presses.

NOTE:  It is recommended that you start a new game for this update.  Loading an old save should work fine but the earnings won't be displayed correctly with the new UI and tracking changes listed below.  New films should get updated and displayed correctly but it can't go back and fix ones that were already saved.  Other than that it does work fine with old saves so obviously, do what you want. :)


 Changed UI in Licensing view so that instead of 'Total Earned' you will see Studio Earnings (money that has actually gone to your studio, both from licensing fees and box office sales beyond the advance) and Box Office Earnings (which is the total the film earned at the box office, regardless of who the money went to).  Hopefully this will help make things more clear about how much your films are earning for you.
 Fixed issue where you could only add one producer to a new film after loading a save game
 Adjusted critic ratings of Actor performances to prevent there being so many 5 star ratings (still totally do-able though)
 Adjusted max values for Camera and Set crews
 Fixed issue in loading saved games that could cause you to not have to repay a distribution company for the advance they gave you
 Added some randomness to the percentage of income from Box Office sales being offered
 Fixed issue that would cause all promises to be listed for both Actors and Directors, instead of only listing the ones relevant to that profession (i.e. clicking Promises when searching for directors will only show promises with Directors)
 Lowered the licensing fees and theatrical distribution advances a bit


Enjoy!  And please stop by the Steam Discussions or email support@caffeinedependentsoftware.com with any questions/concerns/comments.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi!  Time for another update.


Added option for deleting save files in the save/load UI
Adjusted the way distribution companies pick what date to release movies in theaters to limit 'clustering' of movies trying to be released at the same time
Fixed issue where some financing deals that were supposed to have distribution terms attached weren't showing that correctly
Fixed issue where text could be missing when an investor offered you a deal
Added additional world news events


If you have any comments, questions, or concerns please visit the Steam Discussions or email support@caffeinedependentsoftware.com.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix for starting new games
notes.notes: This is a small update to resolve an issue where starting a new game without closing and relaunching the TineseltownTycoon executable will cause some data to be carried over from your previously in progress game.

notes.title: Update time
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, got another update for y'all.


Cleaned up the script revision view to make it more consistent with other UI
Fixed potential crash when searching for writers
Adjusted how some categories are evaluated for awards, this should make it easier for the player to win Best Film, Best Actor, Best Actress, and Best Director awards
Fixed bug that made it possible for AI studios to submit films for awards they weren't really eligible for
Fixed bug where incorrect text was displayed when using a sound stage that you own during preproduction
Fixed bug that would make it impossible to hire new producers immediately after loading a saved game
Added content to the News section of the project info in the Completed tab
Fixed typo in text when investor is offering you a deal
Fixed issue where promises to hire a producer were not updating correctly
Fixed issue where game is unable to select award nominees/winners if you load a game saved under certain conditions
Fixed an issue where loading a game saved under certain conditions will prevent films in theaters from earning correct income for the current weekend
Fixed bug that could prevent writers from asking for an appropriate salary
Adjusted how critics evaluate actors and directors to try and make it a little more even (directors generally have a harder time making a good impression on critics)


If you have any questions, comments, or concerns please let me know in the Steam discussions or send an email to support@caffeinedependentsoftware.com

Enjoy and stay safe!

notes.title: Update - bugfixes and minor additions
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, got another update for you.  Mostly bugfixes but also some minor additions.


Fixed issue with expiration dates of promises
Fixed issue with monthly payment amount for large loans
Fixed missing data issue that could prevent saving the game
Fixed missing text when being offered an investment
Fixed award campaign expenditure not resetting
Fixed description text on some promises
Fixed award text not displaying in Completed view
Fixed typos
Adjusted writer salaries
Adjusted director performances
Randomized starting scripts
Added a few new genres
Added some new names for characters


If you have any issues please let me know in the Steam forum or by emailing support@caffeinedependentsoftware.com.

Hope everyone is staying safe and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
This is a small patch to fix several issues in the game including:


Issues with how promises are applied
Issues with how promises are updated
Bug that could get you locked into the screen for nominated projects for awards
Resolved at least one bug that would prevent user from saving
Fixed some typos
Adjusted some items for balance
Added more info about who you are agreeing to make a promise with
Adjusted some event generation
Resolved minor bugs in production options UI
